title: Code Name: Eternity

ai_content.desc_en: In a world of science fiction and fantasy, astronaut Marcus transforms into Code Name: Eternity, where he finds himself in a battle against evil forces that threaten humanity's future. With his partner, Laura, Marcus embarks on a real-life battle against the first players in the game of life and death.
